title: OPBREAK
description: Advanced Item Management: Anti-Tool-Break, Anti-Armor-Break, Anti-Drop, Anti-Interact, Stats-Tracking, HUD Display and Inventory Full Warning customizable via GUI.
body:
# 🛡️ OPBREAK — Advanced Item Management 🛡️ **Protect Your Gear • Customize Your HUD • Automate the Rest** | | | |---|---| | **Version** | v2.0 | | **Loader** | Fabric | | **Languages** | German / English | --- ## 📜 What is OPBREAK? **OPBREAK** is an All-in-One Fabric Mod for **Item Protection**, **HUD Widgets**, and **QoL Utilities**. Stop losing gear to breaks, drops, or misclicks, track your Items, customize your HUD, and automate the rest.
Fully configurable via GUI. Click on any feature below to see it in action 👇 --- ## 🛡️ Protection
✨ Anti-Tool-Break & Anti-Armor-Break Never lose an important Tool or piece of Armor to accidental breaking again. ![Anti-Tool-Break & Anti-Armor-Break](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bdzb5h4i/images/1010e54def5b6041396fbbeddf77e4bbab87d620.webp) ![Anti-Tool-Break & Anti-Armor-Break Warning](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bdzb5h4i/images/0e2b200e2f5ba8e597e6a29d9424af051a03e044.webp)
🚫 Anti-Interact & Anti-Drop Prevent Items from being dropped by accident and block unwanted Interactions to protect your Items and Inventory. ![Anti-Interact & Anti-Drop](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bdzb5h4i/images/4fb32f4f95856fe054e62160076cad25966b0066.webp)
--- ## 📊 Tracking
📊 Item Stats Tracking Every protected item is tracked in detail. **Tracked Statistics:** - First Seen - Last Warning - Uses - Prevented Uses - Warnings - Broken - Drops - Prevented Drops ![Stats Tracking](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bdzb5h4i/images/1e772a34eb60732add3f46534dae56d978a42a77.webp)
--- ## 🎨 Visuals & Animations
🎬 Disable Vanilla Item Animations Turn off default Minecraft Item Animations for a cleaner, more consistent look. ![Disable Vanilla Item Animations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bdzb5h4i/images/9e6d3d82467125666ee9fa401fe46487160abaf3.webp)
🌟 Custom Item Animations Replace Vanilla Animations with custom Item Animations.
--- ## 🧩 HUD & Widgets
📱 Item Widget Keep an eye on the condition of your most important Items directly on screen. ![Item Widget](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bdzb5h4i/images/c218424f1ed9846d11c973b2dc35808e006a5742.webp)
🎒 Inventory Widget Monitor your full Inventory status at a glance. ![Inventory Widget](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bdzb5h4i/images/10e68241c2a09e995d721ab3e52cbc5eda4c8e7d.webp)
🥋 Armor Widget Monitor your full Armor status at a glance. ![Armor Widget](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bdzb5h4i/images/6b8c6624d4ee7f2313d3039828b17c06679a8ef5.webp)
📏 Resizable Hotbar Adjust the size and position of your Hotbar to fit your playstyle and screen. ![Resizable Hotbar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bdzb5h4i/images/74588d79b2dfec0bfcc914bbb3eb76b93df132e5.webp)
--- ## ⚙️ Utility
🤚 Hand Transformer (Offhand/Mainhand) Automatically transform or manage (global oder specific) Items between your Mainhand and Offhand. ![Hand Transformer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bdzb5h4i/images/22fbfea1194c3d43a145a536980d8db3acc5f7ed.webp)
🖥️ Auto Commands Automatically trigger commands based on custom conditions and Mod events. ![Auto Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bdzb5h4i/images/5ae697335e653570a3befc70f9bce441983b19a1.webp) ![Auto Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bdzb5h4i/images/bef80e11116010367938b30e734e118e65701ef4.png)
❌ Inventory Full Warning Get notified before your Inventory overflows. ![Inventory Full Warning](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bdzb5h4i/images/ecb280767c23cd8b9b215689661ba09b7773cae4.webp)
⚙️ Widget Editor Menu Freely position, resize, and toggle every HUD Widget to fit your setup. ![Widget Editor Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bdzb5h4i/images/018481bd50ddbfb7437bf030352709e64f45e92f.webp)
⚙️ Settings Configure every feature and setting instantly — no commands, no config files. Changes apply immediately in-game. ![Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bdzb5h4i/images/85b367794b499047e1afe1dd2a4fdb4111d03d80.png)
--- ## ⚠️ Disclaimer The OPBREAK Development Team is not responsible for lost or broken Items. Feedback and Bug reports can be submitted via Discord tickets. This Mod is in active development — use responsibly and respect server rules. This Mod automatically downloads and installs Updates from Modrinth on restart. This feature is enabled by default but can be disabled via GUI. © 2026 OPBREAK Development Team
